serverInfo.name: ConsumeBlockingAndDeletionOfDataSubjectsAPIs_NG MCP Server
serverInfo.description: Consume Data Subject Blocking or Deletion in Data Privacy Integration NextGen

tools.name: PUT_blocking_application_dataSubjectBlocking
tools.title: PUT_blocking_application_dataSubjectBlocking
tools.description: This endpoint allows the consuming business application to make a request to the DPI NextGen Retention Management for blocking or deleting a data subject associated with a specific role in an application. The process is synchronous, ensuring that the blocking or deletion occurs immediately, and the response containing the outcome of the blocking operation is returned.

parameters.name: requestBody
parameters.description: The request payload for blocking or deleting a data subject in an application

tools.name: PUT_blocking_application_dataSubjectBlocking_async
tools.title: PUT_blocking_application_dataSubjectBlocking_async
tools.description: This endpoint allows the consuming application to trigger the DPI NextGen Retention Management to block or delete a data subject associated with a specific role in an application. The endpoint operates asynchronously, and the status of the blocking or deletion process can be checked using the data subject blocking status endpoint.

parameters.name: requestBody
parameters.description: The request payload for blocking or deleting a data subject in an application

tools.name: GET_blocking_application_dataSubjectBlocking_requests_requestId
tools.title: GET_blocking_application_dataSubjectBlocking_requests_requestId
tools.description: The consuming application can trigger this endpoint to check the status of a data subject blocking or deletion request in the DPI NextGen Retention Management. The identifier of the request, which was returned as part of the async request, should be provided as a path parameter.

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description: The identifier of the request for which the status of the data subject blocking or deletion request is being checked
